candidates.instruction: Replace the 32-bit counter with an 8-bit counter and remove the explicit `counter == 255` reset branch, relying on 8-bit increment overflow for modulo-256 wrap. Keep the synchronous active-high reset of both counter and `pwm_out`, and keep `pwm_out` registered from the comparison of the pre-increment counter against the zero-extended `duty`. The expected LUT reduction must be confirmed by routed reports; promote only if simulation and all metric gates pass and LUT use is strictly below 7 with WNS and WHS both nonnegative.
